GLOBE investigates how these changing conditions relate to marine microbial community composition, diversity and functional potential. Selected microbial groups, including <i>Vibrio</i> and potentially pathogenic lineages, provide complementary lines of investigation.</p><p>The initiative includes 30 coastal sampling stations in 23 countries, across the Pacific, Atlantic and Indian oceans and the Mediterranean Sea.</p><h2>Observations before and during El Niño</h2><p>The project description specifies monthly sampling, increasing to fortnightly sampling as the El Niño front arrives. Seawater microbes, phytoplankton and zooplankton are considered alongside environmental measurements. Metagenomic sequencing supports comparisons of marine microbiomes before and during the event. Targeted analyses, including studies of <i>Vibrio</i> isolates, complement this community-wide approach.</p><h2>An open network of scientists</h2><p>GLOBE is a free and independent international network of scientists. Researchers can propose coordinated sampling across this worldwide network in response to exceptional ocean events, including El Niño. Participation and new collaborations are welcome; each campaign is developed with the participating teams and agreed local sampling capacity.</p><h2>International identity</h2><p>GLOBE is an independent international scientific collaboration. Participating national networks, including the Italian Omics Observatory Network, contribute to the shared initiative.</p><h2>Coordination and participation</h2><p>Project coordinators, institutional affiliations, funding acknowledgements and partner contacts will be listed after confirmation. No names or affiliations have been inferred.</p></section></div><footer class="site-footer"><div><strong>GLOBE</strong><p>Marine microbiome research.<br>Independent international scientific collaboration.</p></div><p>Project scope: 30 coastal stations · 23 countries<br><a href="../pages/news.html">News</a> · <a href="../pages/resources.html">Sources & resources</a> · <a href="../pages/privacy.html">Privacy & data use</a> · <a href="../pages/members.html">Partner workspace</a><br>Independent international scientific collaboration</p></footer><script src="../assets/js/site.js?v=20261122-continuous"></script>
